name: Garam: Sales ChatBot & LiveChat
author: Minchul Park

sections.description:
Talk with every single visitor. With Garam AI, interacts with customers like an offline store agent.\
This plugin is a part of the (Garam – LiveChat & ChatBot platform)[www.garam.io] that uses AI to enhance the user experience on WordPress E-Commerce sites.
Garam is an AI-powered customer engagement service designed to enhance the shopping experience. When customers visit, Garam assists by answering product-related questions and recommending items tailored to their preferences. For shop owners, Garam is easy to use and requires no complex setup. If Garam needs additional information about a product, it will simply ask the shop owner. Additionally, Garam analyzes conversations with customers, providing valuable insights into customer interest.

  • Garam AI will understand your shopping mall and answer customer inquiries.
  • Shop owner can intervene conversation between customer and AI agent by LiveChat
  • Garam AI will actively talk to visitors for marketing and sales.
  • Garam AI will analyze conversations with customers and provide insight to user.

Garam website: www.garam.io
Privacy link: Garam Privacy
